notes.itemTitle: Close the KITAS and withdraw BPJS
notes.title: InCorp replied with options
notes.text: Chitra was on leave and has come back with a 10 percent discount on all three fees. The useful part is the alternative she offers: cancel the KITAS by ERP after you have left Indonesia, rather than an EPO before. - Ask her what ERP needs, because it would free your passport for the visa.

notes.itemTitle: Upload your CV to VMock for the SMART score
notes.title: VMock scored your CV 63
notes.text: VMock came back yesterday with 63, in the yellow zone. The upload is what this task was for, so I have closed it, and the SMART Editor is what takes the score to green. - Worth one pass this week while the CV is still fresh.
